OFFICE OF THE SUPREME COMMANDER
FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 091.3 (25 Sep 45) ESS
(SCAPIN-59)
25 September 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Securities Exchanges.
You will not permit the opening or reopening of any Stock Exchange, Commodity Exchange or similar institution without prior submission to and approval by the Supreme Commander of the plan of operation of such institution.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ Harold Fair
HAROLD FAIR,
Lt Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General.
